BL-1242 — A QA merge-up silently deletes the rebuilt work of tickets QA reverted, and the only guard that refuses this covers backlog ticket YAMLs alone
What it solves: - [2026-08-28] specifier: minted from the coder note. Claim verified
  independently by merge simulation before minting rather than taken on
  report; the coder attribution to git rename detection is not asserted here
  because the deletions are equally explained by QA bounce reverts
  propagating,…
Approval context: Scope is deliberately one guard, modelled on the BL-901 guard that already exists for backlog ticket YAMLs, reusing its name-it-to-mean-it escape. What needs your sign-off is the escape rather than the refusal: naming the ticket ids in the commit message allows the removal, exactly as BL-901 does. …
BL-1242 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1242" (or "reject BL-1242 <reason>") to act.
